item.title: Craving for beautiful things, Delighting in agreeable forms, Bound by ignorance, Lowly beings Increase their bondage. Even the wise who do unwholesome deeds Born from…
item.description:
Craving for beautiful things,
Delighting in agreeable forms,
Bound by ignorance,
Lowly beings
Increase their bondage.
Even the wise who do unwholesome deeds
Born from greed, hatred, delusion —
Causing distress, discomfort,
Giving rise to suffering —
Are surrounded by ignorance,
Blind, without eyes.
Such is their nature —
They cannot think:
I can be thus.

From: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.66
